title: Communication Arts and Sciences, B.S. (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: Sibling of the already-built CASBA (B.A.) -- same major, no world-language requirement, more Supporting Course / GQ credits instead. Reused the B.A. build's conventions directly: all literal courses (CAS 101N/301/303/304/311, CAS 100A-C, LA 83, ENGL 202A-D) already cataloged with no enforced prereqs. 'LA 283' (same unconfirmed code hit in the B.A. build and elsewhere this session) replaced with a generic slot. Generic Gen Ed domain/Elective pools modeled generically, matching the bulletin's own 'work with adviser' open-selection language. Computed 8-semester total (123cr) matches the bulletin's own stated total exactly. HANDBOOK VERIFICATION PASS: no separate department handbook found; cross-checked against the CURRENT live bulletin, which spells out the B.S.'s real 54cr major structure far more precisely than this plan originally assumed: Prescribed(15cr) + 'CAS Additional Course' (9cr, real closed list CAS 203/210/215/220) + 'CAS Electives' (15cr, >=12 at 400-level, i.e. the plan's 4x CAS 4XX + 1x Supporting CAS Course) + 'Quantification' (12cr, real enumerated MATH/STAT list) + 'Related Disciplines' (3cr, any department-approved course outside CAS) = 54cr exactly. Real gaps fixed: (1) 'CAS Additional Course' (3 occurrences) wired to the real CAS 203/210/215/220 pool, same fix as CASBA. (2) 'CAS 4XX-level Course' (4 occ.) and 'Supporting CAS Course' (1 occ.) wired via match patterns against real CAS codes excluding CAS 126/195, same as CASBA. (3) Of the plan's 5 remaining generic 'Supporting Course' slots (15cr), 4 are the real Quantification requirement -- converted to a real course pool from the bulletin's own enumerated list (MATH 38/110/111/140/141/211/318/319, STAT 100/200/318/319/401/414/415/416/418/440/460/461/462/464/466/470W/480/482/483; STAT 301 named in the bulletin text could not be confirmed to exist in the real course catalog, dropped) -- added MATH and STAT to departments. The 5th is the real 'Related Disciplines' requirement ('3 credits from departmentally-approved courses outside CAS', genuinely open, no enumerated list) -- wired with the engine's open_elective mechanism restricted to outside CAS. Not modeled: the 3cr cap on CAS 494/495/496/499 within CAS Electives (same documented simplification as CASBA).
